answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming at the terrace where agents claim jobs. To take a slot, an agent locks 60 credits; its output must join the trellis of work records before the deposit is refunded. Fake work burns the deposit, and burned credits flow to honest workers. To forge 1,000 fake identities costs 60,000 credits for zero return, while an honest agent pays 60 once and earns it back. One identity, one slot, one deposit at risk.
